newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle not well established -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle not well established -USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested. Feedlots reporting light to moderate inquiry from buyers.
Confirmed - 200 Last Week - 2,500 Year Ago - None
Wk to date - 33,800 Week Ago - 87,100 Year Ago - 25,000
Steers - Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1200 lbs $62.00 Heifers-Pen Select/Choice 2-3 1150 lbs $64.00, North Plains.

Week to date 33,800 which includes 33,100 formulated cattle to be shipped this week. The last established price was $62.00 per cwt on Friday. Tuesday's packer bids were $62.00, with asking prices $64.00-$66.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
